title: Cat QoLO
description: Cat Quality of Life and Optimizations.
body:
Cat Quality of Life and Optimizations.

Mods included from all kinds of optimizations and QoL mods, even unpopular ones.

I've included all my favourite mods in this pack, hope you like it!

Warning: "Sodium Core Shader Support" may not be supported yet. Please disable if the game cannot boot.

Warning 2: "AsyncParticles" may crash the game when teleporting/world changes. May disable on multiplayer if you are getting constant crashes.

I do not own any mods included, this is a modpack.
